title: Trail Cam Empty-Frame Waste Rate
dataSources: iNaturalist observations (`inat:observation`), moth trap sessions (`mothtrap:session`), bat detections (`batdetector:pass`), and trail-cam label events (`trailcam:label`).
app: Backyard biodiversity telemetry from iNaturalist exports, moth-trap image batches, AudioMoth bat detectors, and trail-camera AI labeling pipelines sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trailcam:label
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(label!="empty")) as successful by _time camera_id
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for trail-cam frames by camera.
value: A usable-frame percentage shows whether one camera is mostly burning storage on wind and shadows.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for trail-cam frames events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for trail-cam frames by camera.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates how often trail-cam frames works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
